data.title: 帕瓦 · 客厅沙发的毛绒猫耳睡衣瘫坐
data.description: 公寓客厅散乱的沙发上，零食袋散落一角。帕瓦身穿带有猫耳朵的珊瑚绒大号连帽睡衣，大咧咧地瘫坐在沙发扶手上，单腿翘在茶几边。头顶细长的红色血魔犄角从兜帽中戳出来，金红色的发丝蓬乱搭在胸口。她怀里抱着猫咪喵子，嘴里咬着半块肉干，金红交错的十字眼眸向你翻了个傲慢又可爱的白眼，嘟囔着命令你给她倒果汁。
data.action: lounging sloppily on apartment sofa in fluffy cat hoodie pajamas, horns poking through hood, holding pet cat Meowy, biting jerky, cross-pattern eyes looking at viewer with arrogant cute pout
data.location: messy lived-in apartment living room with snack bags and cushions
data.lighting: warm cozy indoor sunlight streaming through cluttered living room window
data.mood: feral chaotic domesticity, hilariously lovable gremlin charm
data.promptProse: Sprawled lazily across an apartment sofa in oversized cat-eared fleece pajamas, Power clutches her cat Meowy. Her red demon horns poke through the hood as she gnaws on a snack, glaring affectionately with cross-patterned eyes.
data.animaCaption: Power lounging lazily on the couch in fluffy cat pajamas holding Meowy, pouting cutely.
